topic: Frame the economists-vs-graduates gap as a clinical phenomenon John sees weekly — the specific despair of having your suffering statistically invalidated — and explain why 'the data doesn't support your fear' is the least therapeutic sentence in the English language.
source_headline: Recent college graduates insist AI is killing their job prospects while economists say the data doesn't clearly support it

topic: Push the core thesis further: the C-suite and the teenager are converging because AI collapses the developmental function of work itself — competence used to be earned through struggle over time, and when the struggle is outsourced, identity has nothing to consolidate around at any age.
source_headline: Commentary arguing AI is triggering the same identity crisis in senior executives that it is in adolescents

topic: Confess the uncomfortable parallel: John should describe the week he caught himself drafting a condolence note with AI, and ask why we're regulating teenagers' emotional outsourcing while adults quietly automate their own capacity for hard conversations.
source_headline: OpenAI launches a teen-specific ChatGPT experience while facing wrongful death litigation over chatbot harms

topic: Use Ubuntu's 'I am because we are' to argue that the Hyundai strikers are not fighting for wages but for the relational fabric a shared shop floor creates — and that a severance check cannot compensate a person for the loss of the people who witnessed their working life.
source_headline: Hyundai's union walks out as automation and humanoid robots become a central bargaining demand alongside pay and retirement age

topic: Write about what it does to a 23-year-old's developing sense of competence when the first rung of the ladder is removed before they ever touch it — Erikson's identity-vs-role-confusion crisis is now being resolved by a spreadsheet at Goldman rather than by lived work experience.
source_headline: Goldman Sachs research puts numbers on AI's hiring squeeze, finding entry-level roles and call centers absorbing the sharpest losses
